description: Corrects the voltage scaling of a DC-coupled audio interface that has no calibration of its own, so that a volt in Rack is a volt in the eurorack system

params.text: Starts the input calibration and confirms each of its steps; the lamp flashes between presses and the display names what to do
Starts the output calibration and confirms its first step; the module then drives its own To Device jack to 0V and to 3V and measures each of them through From Device

inputs.text: The signal coming back from the audio interface, rescaled by the measured input calibration before it reaches To VCV; every calibration measurement is taken from this jack
The signal to be sent out to the interface; it is pre-compensated by the measured output calibration before it reaches To Device

outputs.text: The signal from the interface with the input calibration applied, so that a volt read here is a volt at the interface
The pre-compensated signal for the audio interface output; during output calibration the module drives this jack itself, to 0V and then to 3V

notes: Calibration needs a 3V reference from your eurorack system, and a cable from the audio interface's physical output back to its own input.
Press Calibrate Input, carry out the step named in the panel display, then press the button again to confirm it; repeat until the display reads Idle, then do the same with Calibrate Output.
Before either calibration has been run the module passes both signals through unchanged, and the two calibrations are stored with the patch.
The panel display is a text window rather than a control, so it cannot be clicked for help; it names the step to carry out and reads Idle when nothing is in progress.
